author: 24-7 Press
title: "You Wouldn't Believe Me If I Told You" Named Runner-Up for Sports Book of the Year
text:
ST. LOUIS, MO, December 03, 2025 /24-7PressRelease/ — Jay Delsing, longtime PGA Tour professional, broadcaster, and St. Louis native, has been named Runner-Up for Sports Book of the Year by the American Writing Awards for his latest book, “ You Wouldn’t Believe Me If I Told You: An Unforgettable Memoir of Golf, Grit, and a Blue-Collar Kid on the PGA Tour .” The national recognition highlights Delsing’s standout contribution to sports literature and his ability to reveal the human side of professional golf.
Part memoir and part behind-the-scenes portrait, “You Wouldn’t Believe Me If I Told You” draws on Delsing’s three decades on the PGA Tour. His storytelling blends candid locker room moments, surprising career truths, and the deeply personal experiences that shaped his life in the game. The award underscores Delsing’s evolution from elite competitor to respected analyst, commentator, and now an honored author.
Delsing continues to be in demand for year-end commentary and 2026 predictions, offering clear and compelling analysis on the state of golf today. His insights include Scottie Scheffler’s dominant 2025 season, Rory McIlroy’s milestone career Grand Slam, the Ryder Cup’s strategic challenges, and the ongoing surge in golf participation across new and diverse demographics. His perspective is informed by decades competing at the highest level and a lifelong understanding of how the game is changing.
“I’m grateful for this recognition,” Delsing said. “The book reflects the stories and lessons that shaped my life inside and outside the ropes. Sharing those experiences with readers has been incredibly meaningful.”
Delsing is also the host of the weekly show and podcast “ Golf with Jay Delsing ,” where he continues to bring thoughtful commentary, high-profile interviews, and insider perspective to audiences nationwide.
“You Wouldn’t Believe Me If I Told You” is available through major booksellers.
About the Author: Jay Delsing is a PGA Tour veteran, Life Member of the PGA Tour and PGA of America, and host of the nationally syndicated radio show “Golf With Jay Delsing,” airing in 50 markets across the US. A two-time All-American and UCLA economics graduate, Jay played professional golf for more than 25 years before moving into broadcasting. His new memoir, “ You Wouldn’t Believe Me If I Told You: An Unforgettable Memoir of Golf, Grit, and a Blue-Collar Kid on the PGA Tour ,” is a lively and heartfelt behind-the-ropes look at the PGA Tour, offering lessons in grit, integrity, and leadership. Jay’s mission is to grow the game, inspire audiences, and share golf’s power to connect people. Learn more at JayDelsingGolf.com .
For more information, visit the online press kit at jaydelsing.onlinepresskit247.com and public site JayDelsingGolf.com .
